title: Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is the role where attorneys stop worrying about whether anything is going to slip through the cracks. Calendars they trust. Dockets that don't drift. Court, BIA, and tribal-court filings that always go through. Billing that closes on schedule. Confidential records handled with the discretion the work requires.


Our client is a leading Arizona litigation firm headquartered in Phoenix, with active practices in commercial litigation, civil rights, employment law, and Federal Indian Law — including matters before the Bureau of Indian Affairs and tribal courts. The firm represents businesses, individuals, families, and tribal nation interests, and offers the expertise of large national firms with a smaller, more personal approach.


The firm runs on Clio for case management, calendaring, and billing. You will support attorneys and the onshore team directly — owning the operational discipline that determines whether the lawyers can focus on the law or get pulled into the operational background. This is a substantive operational ownership role, not a queue-clearing admin seat.


Success at 90 days: zero missed deadlines, calendars attorneys rely on without checking twice, clean billing close, organized matter files. Success at one year: you know BIA procedures and tribal court rules well enough that attorneys default to you for procedural questions, not the other way around.


Key Responsibilities

Docketing & Calendar Management

  • Docket hearings, court dates, filing deadlines, BIA deadlines, tribal court deadlines, and critical case milestones in Clio.
  • Set structured multi-tier reminder cascades for every deadline (30-day, 14-day, 7-day, 2-day, day-of) — never a single calendar entry.
  • Manage attorney calendars including appointments, court dates, depositions, agency hearings, internal deadlines, and travel windows.
  • Surface upcoming deadlines and scheduling conflicts to attorneys with sufficient lead time — proactively, not reactively.

Meeting, Deposition & Travel Coordination

  • Coordinate scheduling for client meetings, depositions, hearings, agency appearances, and internal team meetings.
  • Arrange travel logistics for attorneys (flights, accommodations, transportation, itineraries) for hearings and client visits.
  • Prepare deposition logistics including notices, court reporter coordination, and witness confirmation.
  • Confirm all logistics in advance and communicate relevant details to all parties.

Legal Document Preparation

  • Prepare, edit, proofread, and format pleadings, motions, briefs, correspondence, and other legal materials to filing-ready quality.
  • Ensure all documents meet applicable court, agency, and firm formatting standards before filing or distribution.
  • Maintain version control and organized document files across all active matters inside Clio.
  • Assist attorneys with drafting standard correspondence and follow-up communications as directed.

Court & Agency Filing

  • E-file with federal district courts (CM-ECF/PACER), Arizona state courts, BIA, and tribal courts as applicable.
  • Confirm acceptance of every filing via NEF or equivalent — submission is not the same as acceptance.
  • Maintain organized records of all submissions, confirmations, and proofs of service.
  • Stay current on e-filing requirements for the courts and agencies the firm uses.

Case & File Management (Clio)

  • Maintain matter records inside Clio with consistent naming conventions and complete metadata.
  • Track case activity and organize supporting documentation.
  • Maintain and organize physical and digital client files.
  • Handle confidential client records and case information with the highest level of discretion and in compliance with applicable professional responsibility rules.
  • Support case intake — opening new matters in Clio, gathering client information, preparing conflict checks.

Billing, Invoicing & Expense Tracking

  • Track attorney time entries, billing activity, and client invoices inside Clio.
  • Assist with preparation and distribution of client billing statements.
  • Process and track expense reports and reimbursements.
  • Flag missing time entries, overdue invoices, or discrepancies to the appropriate team member before billing close.

Compliance & Procedure

  • Maintain awareness of procedural rules relevant to the firm's Indian law practice — federal administrative procedures, tribal court rules, federal court local rules, BIA processes.
  • Support the firm's compliance with document retention, confidentiality, and professional responsibility obligations.
  • Ensure all administrative procedures comply with applicable legal, court, and agency requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a legal admin, legal secretary, or paralegal role supporting a US litigation practice (or strongly comparable international firm).
  • Hands-on US court e-filing experience (CM-ECF, PACER, AZTurboCourt, or similar) — direct workflow experience, not familiarity.
  • Direct experience managing multiple attorney calendars with structured, multi-tier deadline cascades.
  • Excellent written English — documents you prepare or proofread require minimal attorney correction.
  • Meticulous attention to detail. Accuracy in legal documents and deadlines is non-negotiable.
  • High discretion in handling confidential client and case information.
  • Self-directed and reliable in a remote work environment.
  • Stable home office: high-speed internet, backup power or backup internet, quiet workspace, modern computer with webcam.


Strong Plus, Not Required

  • Direct paid Clio experience — matter setup, calendar integration, document management, and billing.
  • Equivalent experience with Filevine, MyCase, ProLaw, Smokeball, or comparable case management systems.
  • Familiarity with Bureau of Indian Affairs procedures, tribal court rules, or federal administrative practice.
  • Experience with LEDES invoicing or other legal billing standards.
  • 12+ months of sustained US-firm remote experience.


How We Work

  • 100% remote.
  • full-time contractor.
  • Compensation: up to $6/hr USD.


Application

Complete the required Aptive Index assessment here and provide a comprehensive resume.

Link:


By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only.


Scheduling: initial calls run in US Mountain Standard Time, within a 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST window — which translates locally to 6:00 PM – 4:00 AM in the Philippines, 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM in South Africa, 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM in Brazil, and 4:00 AM – 2:00 PM in Guatemala.

title: Educational Content Producer (Remote / LATAM Preferred)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Educational Content Producer (Remote / LATAM Preferred) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping SoundMind Training LLC find a top candidate to join their team part-time for the role of Educational Content Producer (Remote / LATAM Preferred) .


You'll transform expert conversations into accessible, multi-modal learning experiences for a global audience.


Compensation:

USD 12 - 17/hour


Location:

Remote (specific timezones) - GMT-10:00 to GMT-02:00


Mission of SoundMind Training LLC:

\"To address the global burden of mental health through a variety of initiatives: medical and mental health treatment, as well as training and supporting exceptionally skilled, ethical psychedelic facilitators from diverse backgrounds, expanding safe, inclusive, and innovative practice in the psychedelic ecosystem. We aim to use AI-assisted technology to scale our protocols to address mental health burden around the world. \"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You are proficient in Stakeholder management, Project management, Online learning, LMS administration, Knowledge management, Instructional design.
  • English - Fully fluent


Responsibilities and more:

Educational Content Producer


SoundMind is seeking an Educational Content Producer to help build a new platform centered around conversations, learning, intellectual curiosity, and accessibility.


The role will support Dr. Hannah McLane in producing interviews, educational content, learning experiences, and member resources across topics including psychology, psychoanalysis, neurodiversity, trauma, coercive control, psychedelics, contemplative traditions, medicine, creativity, and human development.


This is not a traditional podcast production role. We are looking for someone who loves learning, enjoys working with experts and educators, and is excited about transforming conversations into meaningful educational experiences.


What You'll Help Create

  • Each month, Dr. Hannah interviews researchers, clinicians, philosophers, educators, artists, and other thought leaders.


You will help transform those conversations into:

  • Learning collections
  • Reading guides
  • Discussion questions
  • Course modules
  • Summaries and key takeaways
  • Member resources
  • Accessibility-focused learning materials
  • Podcast and video content


Responsibilities


Content Production

  • Coordinate guest interviews and recordings
  • Organize transcripts and source materials
  • Create educational summaries and discussion guides
  • Curate reading lists and supplemental resources
  • Organize content into themed learning collections
  • Assist with course and membership content development


Faculty & Guest Coordination

  • Schedule guests and manage communications
  • Collect bios, headshots, readings, and permissions
  • Prepare briefing materials before interviews
  • Ensure recordings, assets, and materials are properly organized


Learning Experience Design

  • Help create engaging learning experiences from expert conversations
  • Work with subject matter experts to develop educational materials
  • Assist in organizing content for LMS platforms and member portals
  • Identify opportunities for future courses, collections, and educational offerings


Accessibility & Multi-Modal Learning

  • We are particularly interested in making learning more accessible across different learning styles and neurotypes.


You may help develop:

  • ADHD-friendly summaries
  • Dyslexia-friendly formats
  • Text-to-speech resources
  • Audio versions of readings
  • Visual learning aids
  • Multi-modal educational experiences


Ideal Background


You may be:

  • An instructional designer
  • Educational content producer
  • Learning experience designer
  • Curriculum developer
  • Educational project manager
  • Online learning specialist


Experience with any of the following is helpful:

  • LMS platforms (Kajabi, Canvas, Blackboard, Thinkific, etc.)
  • Course development
  • Podcast or video production
  • Educational technology
  • Adult learning
  • Psychology, healthcare, coaching, or wellness education


What We're Looking For


The ideal person is:

  • Curious
  • Organized
  • Excellent at written communication
  • Comfortable coordinating busy experts
  • Interested in lifelong learning
  • Able to transform complex ideas into accessible educational experiences
  • Excited by intellectual conversations and interdisciplinary thinking


Most importantly, we are looking for someone who loves helping ideas come alive.


Compensation: $10–15 USD/hour depending on experience.LATAM strongly preferred. Part-time contract role with opportunity to grow as the platform expands.


Your potential leader:

  • Hannah McLane

title: Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is the role where attorneys stop worrying about whether anything is going to slip through the cracks. Calendars they trust. Dockets that don't drift. Court, BIA, and tribal-court filings that always go through. Billing that closes on schedule. Confidential records handled with the discretion the work requires.


Our client is a leading Arizona litigation firm headquartered in Phoenix, with active practices in commercial litigation, civil rights, employment law, and Federal Indian Law — including matters before the Bureau of Indian Affairs and tribal courts. The firm represents businesses, individuals, families, and tribal nation interests, and offers the expertise of large national firms with a smaller, more personal approach.


The firm runs on Clio for case management, calendaring, and billing. You will support attorneys and the onshore team directly — owning the operational discipline that determines whether the lawyers can focus on the law or get pulled into the operational background. This is a substantive operational ownership role, not a queue-clearing admin seat.


Success at 90 days: zero missed deadlines, calendars attorneys rely on without checking twice, clean billing close, organized matter files. Success at one year: you know BIA procedures and tribal court rules well enough that attorneys default to you for procedural questions, not the other way around.


Key Responsibilities

Docketing & Calendar Management

  • Docket hearings, court dates, filing deadlines, BIA deadlines, tribal court deadlines, and critical case milestones in Clio.
  • Set structured multi-tier reminder cascades for every deadline (30-day, 14-day, 7-day, 2-day, day-of) — never a single calendar entry.
  • Manage attorney calendars including appointments, court dates, depositions, agency hearings, internal deadlines, and travel windows.
  • Surface upcoming deadlines and scheduling conflicts to attorneys with sufficient lead time — proactively, not reactively.

Meeting, Deposition & Travel Coordination

  • Coordinate scheduling for client meetings, depositions, hearings, agency appearances, and internal team meetings.
  • Arrange travel logistics for attorneys (flights, accommodations, transportation, itineraries) for hearings and client visits.
  • Prepare deposition logistics including notices, court reporter coordination, and witness confirmation.
  • Confirm all logistics in advance and communicate relevant details to all parties.

Legal Document Preparation

  • Prepare, edit, proofread, and format pleadings, motions, briefs, correspondence, and other legal materials to filing-ready quality.
  • Ensure all documents meet applicable court, agency, and firm formatting standards before filing or distribution.
  • Maintain version control and organized document files across all active matters inside Clio.
  • Assist attorneys with drafting standard correspondence and follow-up communications as directed.

Court & Agency Filing

  • E-file with federal district courts (CM-ECF/PACER), Arizona state courts, BIA, and tribal courts as applicable.
  • Confirm acceptance of every filing via NEF or equivalent — submission is not the same as acceptance.
  • Maintain organized records of all submissions, confirmations, and proofs of service.
  • Stay current on e-filing requirements for the courts and agencies the firm uses.

Case & File Management (Clio)

  • Maintain matter records inside Clio with consistent naming conventions and complete metadata.
  • Track case activity and organize supporting documentation.
  • Maintain and organize physical and digital client files.
  • Handle confidential client records and case information with the highest level of discretion and in compliance with applicable professional responsibility rules.
  • Support case intake — opening new matters in Clio, gathering client information, preparing conflict checks.

Billing, Invoicing & Expense Tracking

  • Track attorney time entries, billing activity, and client invoices inside Clio.
  • Assist with preparation and distribution of client billing statements.
  • Process and track expense reports and reimbursements.
  • Flag missing time entries, overdue invoices, or discrepancies to the appropriate team member before billing close.

Compliance & Procedure

  • Maintain awareness of procedural rules relevant to the firm's Indian law practice — federal administrative procedures, tribal court rules, federal court local rules, BIA processes.
  • Support the firm's compliance with document retention, confidentiality, and professional responsibility obligations.
  • Ensure all administrative procedures comply with applicable legal, court, and agency requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a legal admin, legal secretary, or paralegal role supporting a US litigation practice (or strongly comparable international firm).
  • Hands-on US court e-filing experience (CM-ECF, PACER, AZTurboCourt, or similar) — direct workflow experience, not familiarity.
  • Direct experience managing multiple attorney calendars with structured, multi-tier deadline cascades.
  • Excellent written English — documents you prepare or proofread require minimal attorney correction.
  • Meticulous attention to detail. Accuracy in legal documents and deadlines is non-negotiable.
  • High discretion in handling confidential client and case information.
  • Self-directed and reliable in a remote work environment.
  • Stable home office: high-speed internet, backup power or backup internet, quiet workspace, modern computer with webcam.


Strong Plus, Not Required

  • Direct paid Clio experience — matter setup, calendar integration, document management, and billing.
  • Equivalent experience with Filevine, MyCase, ProLaw, Smokeball, or comparable case management systems.
  • Familiarity with Bureau of Indian Affairs procedures, tribal court rules, or federal administrative practice.
  • Experience with LEDES invoicing or other legal billing standards.
  • 12+ months of sustained US-firm remote experience.


How We Work

  • 100% remote.
  • full-time contractor.
  • Compensation: up to $6/hr USD.


Application

Complete the required Aptive Index assessment here and provide a comprehensive resume.

Link:


By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only.


Scheduling: initial calls run in US Mountain Standard Time, within a 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST window — which translates locally to 6:00 PM – 4:00 AM in the Philippines, 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM in South Africa, 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM in Brazil, and 4:00 AM – 2:00 PM in Guatemala.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Mobile Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Mobile Engineer (React + React Native)


LATAM | Remote | EST-Aligned | International Independent Contractor


Compensation: USD $3,000–$4,000/month (based on experience)


About the Company


Our client is a rapidly growing U.S.-based technology company transforming how consumers and investors access and analyze real estate data. Their platform serves over one million users and is built around a culture of rapid experimentation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.


The team operates in a highly collaborative environment with fast development cycles, lean processes, and a strong emphasis on shipping impactful features quickly. Engineers have direct influence on product direction and regularly see their work reach production.


About the Role


We're seeking a Mobile Engineer with experience building both web and mobile applications using React and React Native. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating polished user experiences, working closely with product leadership, and contributing to applications used at scale.


You'll collaborate with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to build, enhance, and optimize both web and mobile experiences while helping shape the technical direction of a growing platform.


What You'll Do


  • Build and maintain modern web applications using React and Next.js.
  • Develop and enhance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Deliver high-quality features across web and mobile platforms with a focus on usability, performance, and reliability.
  • Optimize application performance, rendering, routing, and component architecture.
  • Collaborate with designers, product stakeholders, and backend engineers to implement new functionality.
  • Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs while ensuring efficient state management and error handling.
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, code reviews, and ongoing product discussions.
  • Contribute to front-end architecture decisions and engineering best practices.
  • Write and maintain automated tests to support long-term application stability and maintainability.


Required Qualifications


  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience developing web applications with React .
  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience building mobile applications with React Native .
  • Strong knowledge of React.js and Next.js, including routing, SSR, SSG, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Experience developing and maintaining React Native applications for iOS and Android.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and asynchronous programming concepts.
  • Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI development practices.
  • Experience working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative product environment.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Exposure to Node.js environments such as Express or NestJS.
  • Experience working on data-intensive, analytics, marketplace, or real estate technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with mobile performance optimization and native module integrations.


What We're Looking For


  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.
  • Proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of projects and outcomes.
  • Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills.
  • Comfortable working directly with leadership and contributing ideas.
  • Adaptable and energized by fast-moving environments where iteration and continuous improvement are valued.


Work Details


Location: Latin America (Remote)

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST)

Employment Type: Full-Time International Independent Contractor


If you're excited about building products used by millions of users, enjoy moving quickly, and want to make a meaningful impact across both web and mobile platforms, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics

Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content

  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication

  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

  • Soft Skills: Strong initiative, creative thinking, and the ability to work in a collaborative, innovative, flexible, and team-oriented environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.


.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CMS Exposure : Exposure to popular proprietary or open-source CMS systems such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to be a key member of our Content Management engineering team

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote AI Quality Analyst (German) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • German Proficiency: Ability to read and write in German with a high degree of comp, as German is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months
  • Our offered rate for this project is $15 per hour.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .

title: Tech Lead
description:

Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Local de trabalho: Remoto


Modelo de trabalho: CLT


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Delegar tarefas e atribuições ao time técnico, dando todo o apoio necessário para que evoluam rapidamente na perspectiva técnica, se tornando de alta performance
  • Conduzir efetivos 1:1 com o seu time técnico
  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico (usuário, veículo, débitos, pagamentos, etc).
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Conduzir a resolução de problemas e contribuir ativamente com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Python, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhecer todas essas tecnologias, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.
  • Conduzir auditorias de segurança e estrutura em busca de oportunidades de melhorias.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Possuir experiência na liderança e gestão para condução de um time técnico
  • Habilidade em negociar e se relacionar com diversas áreas, criando as pontes necessárias para destravar as entregas do time
  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação e banco de dados relacional.
  • Ter experiência com mensageria na comunicação entre serviços
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful.
  • Pessoas que buscam aprender e fazer parte de uma solução de alto impacto, entregando software de alta qualidade e orientado por dados.


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis focadas no cliente;
  • Possuir experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.;
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo;
  • Conhecer metodologia Scrum e agilidade;
  • Tiver Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Sabe testar e escalar.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React & Node)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (React & Node) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (React & Node.js) com forte experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos, arquitetura de microfrontends, sistemas distribuídos e backend escalável.


O(a) profissional ideal possui profundo conhecimento em arquitetura moderna de frontend (React 18+, Microfrontends, Zustand, React Query, Next.js) e backend robusto com Node.js e NestJS, aplicando Clean Code, SOLID, DDD e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Será responsável por desenhar soluções escaláveis, garantindo performance, confiabilidade, segurança e integração entre múltiplos sistemas.


Responsabilidades:


Frontend (React)

  • Desenvolver aplicações escaláveis com React 18+ utilizando hooks avançados e composition patterns.
  • Implementar e manter arquitetura de Microfrontends (Single-SPA) .
  • Gerenciar estados assíncronos com Zustand, zustand-pub e React Query .
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis e responsivos com Styled Components .
  • Otimizar performance (Suspense, lazy loading, memoization).
  • Implementar fluxo offline e deduplicação de requisições.
  • Configurar e otimizar Webpack 5 .
  • Desenvolver testes unitários e de integração (Jest).
  • Implementar monitoramento com Sentry, Datadog ou NewRelic.
  • Aplicar Clean Code, SOLID e DDD no frontend.
  • Integrar soluções de pagamento (Pix, boletos, gateways).
  • Atuar em ambientes com CI/CD e Docker.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 25-30/hr USD.



Required Qualifications

  • CMS Backend: Strong PHP development experience and deep familiarity with the Symfony framework, Composer package management, and Twig templating engine.
  • API Experience: 3+ years experience designing and writing content-driven GraphQL and REST APIs in microservices-based architectures.
  • Data & Search: Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with popular open-source RDBMS, plus search technology such as Solr or Elasticsearch.
  • Cloud & Containers: Experience with cloud architecture (ideally AWS) and production experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Engineering Fundamentals: Excellent understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design, with strong ability to architect and develop enterprise-level applications and backend systems.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Process & Tooling: Experience working with agile processes and version control systems (Git).
  • Education & Experience: BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade backend services and content platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in server-side languages, asynchronous programming, and modern object-oriented design patterns.
  • Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST and GraphQL) in microservices-based architectures.
  • Experience modeling complex data flows and schemas for transactional and integration workflows.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or OCI) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with distributed systems concepts including caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including use of monitoring/observability tools.
  • Soft Skills: Strong initiative, creative thinking, and the ability to work in a collaborative, innovative, flexible, and team-oriented environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.


.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CMS Exposure : Exposure to popular proprietary or open-source CMS systems such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento.
  • Additional Languages : Exposure to Golang and/or Rust for performance-critical services.
  • Cloud Focus : 3+ years working with cloud technologies (AWS is strongly preferred).
  • Certifications : Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, OCI).
  • Frontend Skills : Working knowledge of Node.js, TypeScript, and React/Next.js sufficient to collaborate on full-stack features and contribute to shared tooling.
  • Web Fundamentals : Familiarity with HTML, CSS (layout, specificity, cross-browser compatibility), and Web Components.
  • Collaboration : Proven experience in cross-team collaboration for requirements, implementation, and testing.
  • AI Tooling : Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to optimize engineering workflows.
  • Enthusiasm : Enthusiasm for learning new frameworks and languages.


We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to be a key member of our Content Management engineering team


What You Will Do

  • Architect Backend Services: Design and develop new business-led content management services and APIs with an emphasis on performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Drive Full-Stack Solutions: Work closely with DevOps on backend solutions to complex problems, ensuring scale and availability across our content platforms.
  • Build CMS Infrastructure: Develop services and APIs that enable editors to create visually-rich and data-driven content experiences, and streamline backend workflows so stakeholders can produce more content quicker.
  • Integrate AI/ML: Integrate content classification ML/AI processes and pipelines to better annotate video and image assets, enabling smarter aggregation and distribution.
  • Modernize Legacy Systems: Upgrade and migrate existing legacy backend services into modern frameworks, and adapt and optimize current systems for deployment on cloud-based infrastructure.
  • Platform Consolidation: Facilitate better content distribution and aggregation within the various business units, and contribute to consolidating distinct CMS platforms used across the organization.
  • Operational Excellence: Provide engineering support to stakeholders, ensuring a high level of service availability with appropriate testing, monitoring, observability, and alerting.
  • Data Modeling: Model complex data flows and schemas for transactional and integration workflows powering editorial and consumer-facing experiences.
  • Collaborate and Prototype: Work closely within a small engineering group, partnering with design and product teams to rapidly design, develop, and prototype solutions to key business challenges.
  • Mentor and Document: Contribute to clear documentation and diagrams to facilitate easy onboarding for other engineers and support teams. Review code to ensure adherence to best practices (style, testability, efficiency).

title: Estagiário de Experimentação CRO/UX
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Estagiário de Experimentação CRO/UX em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a ETUS

Somos uma MadTech, atuamos na interseção entre marketing, mídia e tecnologia, com soluções que conectam marcas e pessoas de forma estratégica, automatizada e orientada por dados.

ETUS significa Eu Tenho Um Sonho. Nascemos com o propósito de transformar vidas por meio do empreendedorismo, da inclusão e da inovação. Em poucos anos, construímos um ecossistema completo de empresas focadas em performance, mídia programática, inteligência de dados, tecnologia SaaS e otimização de conversão (CRO).

Hoje, impactamos milhões de pessoas, com uma equipe apaixonada por desafios, crescimento e propósito. Aqui, acreditamos que sonhar é o primeiro passo para transformar realidades.

Se você procura um ambiente dinâmico, e já se imaginou trabalhando com um bando de gente incrível, que ama o impossível e está sempre disposta a mudar o jogo, seu lugar é aqui.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta vaga é para atuar na Supersonic, uma das marcas que fazem parte do ecossistema ETUS.

A Supersonic é especializada em crescimento digital, performance e otimização de resultados, atuando de forma estratégica na construção de experiências digitais orientadas por dados, conversão e comportamento do usuário. Com foco em inovação, tecnologia e experimentação, a empresa desenvolve soluções voltadas para aumento de performance, evolução de produtos digitais e aceleração de resultados para diferentes negócios e segmentos.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mente curiosa, olhar analítico e forte interesse por CRO e Experimentação para atuar em projetos de diferentes nichos, modelos de negócio e contextos digitais. Alguém que queira ir além de ajustes superficiais de interface e fazer parte de uma rotina que une estratégia, comportamento do usuário, análise de dados, copywriting, UX, otimização contínua e construção de hipóteses com potencial real de impacto.

Essa pessoa atuará diretamente na identificação de oportunidades ao longo das jornadas e funis de conversão, estruturando análises, levantando hipóteses, conduzindo iniciativas de otimização e contribuindo para a evolução da maturidade de experimentação nos projetos e clientes atendidos pela Supersonic.

Buscamos um perfil que enxergue CRO como uma disciplina estratégica, estruturada e orientada por dados, aprendizado contínuo e conexão genuína com os objetivos do negócio. Esperamos alguém com autonomia, senso crítico e iniciativa no uso de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia, entendendo que o trabalho de CRO evoluiu significativamente nos últimos anos e exige profissionais cada vez mais conectados às novas possibilidades de pesquisa, análise, automação e execução.

● Apoiar análises de páginas, jornadas e funis de conversão.

● Ajudar na identificação de fricções, dúvidas, objeções e oportunidades de melhoria.

● Realizar pesquisas sobre usuários, concorrentes, linguagem, dores e motivações.

● Apoiar a organização de hipóteses, aprendizados, referências e materiais dos projetos.

● Contribuir com análises qualitativas e quantitativas, sempre com orientação do time.

● Apoiar criação e revisão de copy, estrutura de páginas, clareza de mensagens e experiência do usuário.

● Trabalhar em parceria com profissionais de CRO, design, analytics, tecnologia e atendimento.

● Utilizar ferramentas de IA para apoiar pesquisas, análises, organização e produtividade.

● Participar de reuniões, acompanhamentos e apresentações junto ao time, desenvolvendo comunicação e visão estratégica.

O que esperamos de você:

● Afinidade com CRO, UX, comportamento do usuário, marketing digital ou dados.

● Interesse por investigação, pesquisa, análise e resolução de problemas.

● Boa escrita e capacidade de organizar ideias com clareza.

● Boa comunicação verbal para participar de reuniões, explicar raciocínios e conduzir apresentações.

● Curiosidade para aprender ferramentas, processos e metodologias.

● Interesse em utilizar IA como ferramenta de trabalho.

● Organização, responsabilidade e autonomia para atuar em contexto remoto.

● Abertura para feedbacks e disposição para evoluir rapidamente.

● Capacidade de pedir ajuda com clareza, contextualizando o que tentou fazer e onde encontrou dificuldade.

● Boa convivência em equipe e postura adequada no contato com clientes internos e externos.

Diferenciais desejáveis:

● Noções de Figma.

● Noções de GA4, dashboards ou planilhas.

● Interesse por testes A/B e experimentação.

● Interesse por copywriting e escrita persuasiva.

● Interesse por UX Research.

● Contato com ferramentas de mapa de calor, gravações de sessão ou análise de comportamento.

● Curiosidade por IA, automação e novas ferramentas de trabalho.



A contratação será para atuação em regime remoto, com possibilidade de deslocamentos pontuais à sede ao longo do ano, conforme necessidade. Todas as despesas relacionadas às viagens serão custeadas pela empresa.

Wellhub | Gympass – Acesso a academias, personal trainers, estúdios e apps de bem-estar para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

Vale Celebration – Um mimo em momentos importantes como casamento, nascimento de filhos e aniversário.1

️ ♂️ AVUS, Starbem e DASA – Parceiras de saúde e bem-estar que completam o nosso cuidado integral com você.

️ Curso de idiomas (inglês ou espanhol) – Para expandir horizontes e crescer junto com a gente.

Horário flexível – Para facilitar sua rotina.


Se interessou? Então bora se candidatar e venha transformar vidas com a gente!!

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer Technical Lead em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Previdas

A Previdas é uma healthtech/legaltech que conecta escritórios de advocacia previdenciária a médicos peritos para emissão de laudos técnicos. Operamos com receita recorrente, centenas de escritórios ativos e um time enxuto de produto e tecnologia. Buscamos um(a) engenheiro(a) de software sênior para liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, combinando execução técnica de alto nível com a responsabilidade de elevar a qualidade e a maturidade da engenharia na empresa.


Sobre a Vaga

Esta é uma posição de liderança técnica com forte componente de execução. Você será responsável por definir padrões de engenharia, conduzir code reviews e orientar as decisões arquiteturais do time, ao mesmo tempo em que contribui diretamente no desenvolvimento de features e na resolução de problemas críticos em produção. É uma oportunidade para quem quer ter impacto real em um produto com usuários ativos e receita, com autonomia para moldar a direção técnica da plataforma.


O que Esperamos

Perfil

Pragmatismo e foco em entrega — prioriza soluções funcionais e itera a partir delas

Mentalidade de resolução definitiva — investiga a causa raiz em vez de tratar apenas os sintomas

Visão de produto — entende que o valor de uma feature se mede pela experiência do usuário final

Comunicação clara com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos

Senso de prioridade — diferencia o que é urgente do que é interessante, e age de acordo


Responsabilidades

Definir e evoluir a arquitetura dos sistemas da Previdas, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, modularidade e alinhamento com a estratégia de produto.

Liderar o processo de arquitetura da plataforma, consolidando sistemas legados e MVPs paralelos em uma estrutura coesa e sustentável.

Atuar como referência técnica e liderança de engenharia para o time, orientando decisões arquiteturais, padrões de código, modelagem de domínio e boas práticas.

Conduzir code reviews estratégicos, focando em qualidade, manutenibilidade, redução de complexidade e evolução contínua do código.

Resolver incidentes críticos em produção, especialmente integrações com parceiros (APIs externas, webhooks, contratos de integração), garantindo estabilidade do ecossistema.

Definir padrões de versionamento, documentação técnica e governança de código, promovendo previsibilidade e rastreabilidade.

Apoiar decisões estratégicas de produto sob a ótica técnica, avaliando riscos, impacto arquitetural e viabilidade de novas iniciativas.


Requisitos


Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida (mín. 4 anos) em arquitetura de software, com participação ativa em decisões estruturais e definição de padrões técnicos.

Vivência prática com sistemas monolíticos e arquitetura orientada a serviços (microservices), compreendendo trade-offs, estratégias de modularização e evolução incremental.

Domínio de modelagem de dados, estruturas de dados e bancos relacionais, incluindo desenho de schemas, performance, integridade e escalabilidade.

Experiência comprovada em refatoração e modernização de sistemas legados, conduzindo upgrades de stack, reorganização arquitetural e redução de débito técnico.

Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações web e boas práticas de segurança.

Experiência com versionamento de código (Git), ambientes cloud e pipelines de CI/CD, promovendo automação, qualidade e previsibilidade nas entregas.

Capacidade de comunicação estratégica em contexto de liderança técnica, traduzindo decisões arquiteturais para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

Diferenciais


Experiência com as tecnologias utilizadas em nossos projetos, Angular, NestJS, MySQL.

Vivência com Docker e orquestração de containers, conhecimento da DigitalOcean.

Experiência prévia como referência técnica ou tech lead em times reduzidos

Experiência com plataformas de telemedicina ou healthtech.


Condições

Contratação modelo PJ

Trabalho 100% remoto

Autonomia para definir padrões técnicos e direcionamento arquitetural

Empresa com operação em fase Scale-up.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Management Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for a Data Management Coordinator to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and supports day-to-day operations related to account setup and billing processes for our US business.


In this role, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining account records, ensuring billing information is accurate, and supporting system configurations used in pricing and invoicing.

This is a great opportunity for someone detail-oriented who enjoys working with structured processes and has an interest in systems and operational data.


Responsibilities

  • Set up and maintain account records in internal systems;
  • Ensure all billing information is complete and accurate;
  • Process incoming requests through internal tools (e.g., ticketing system);
  • Update account details, contacts, and billing structures as needed;
  • Support system updates related to pricing and billing configurations;
  • Investigate and resolve issues related to billing or data inconsistencies;
  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth operational processes;
  • Meet defined timelines and maintain high data accuracy standards.


Requirements

  • Experience in administrative, finance, accounting, or data-related roles;
  • Strong Excel skills (e.g., Pivot Tables, data comparison);
  • Professional English communication skills;
  • High attention to detail and organization;
  • Ability to follow structured processes and handle repetitive tasks.


Nice to have

  • Experience with billing, invoicing, or financial data;
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools or internal systems.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong attention to detail;
  • Organized and process-driven mindset;
  • Comfortable working with large volumes of data;
  • Problem-solving skills, especially when dealing with discrepancies;
  • Ability to collaborate across teams.


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Mobile Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Mobile Engineer (React + React Native)


LATAM | Remote | EST-Aligned | International Independent Contractor


Compensation: USD $3,000–$4,000/month (based on experience)


About the Company


Our client is a rapidly growing U.S.-based technology company transforming how consumers and investors access and analyze real estate data. Their platform serves over one million users and is built around a culture of rapid experimentation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.


The team operates in a highly collaborative environment with fast development cycles, lean processes, and a strong emphasis on shipping impactful features quickly. Engineers have direct influence on product direction and regularly see their work reach production.


About the Role


We're seeking a Mobile Engineer with experience building both web and mobile applications using React and React Native. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating polished user experiences, working closely with product leadership, and contributing to applications used at scale.


You'll collaborate with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to build, enhance, and optimize both web and mobile experiences while helping shape the technical direction of a growing platform.


What You'll Do


  • Build and maintain modern web applications using React and Next.js.
  • Develop and enhance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Deliver high-quality features across web and mobile platforms with a focus on usability, performance, and reliability.
  • Optimize application performance, rendering, routing, and component architecture.
  • Collaborate with designers, product stakeholders, and backend engineers to implement new functionality.
  • Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs while ensuring efficient state management and error handling.
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, code reviews, and ongoing product discussions.
  • Contribute to front-end architecture decisions and engineering best practices.
  • Write and maintain automated tests to support long-term application stability and maintainability.


Required Qualifications


  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience developing web applications with React .
  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience building mobile applications with React Native .
  • Strong knowledge of React.js and Next.js, including routing, SSR, SSG, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Experience developing and maintaining React Native applications for iOS and Android.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and asynchronous programming concepts.
  • Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI development practices.
  • Experience working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative product environment.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Exposure to Node.js environments such as Express or NestJS.
  • Experience working on data-intensive, analytics, marketplace, or real estate technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with mobile performance optimization and native module integrations.


What We're Looking For


  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.
  • Proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of projects and outcomes.
  • Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills.
  • Comfortable working directly with leadership and contributing ideas.
  • Adaptable and energized by fast-moving environments where iteration and continuous improvement are valued.


Work Details


Location: Latin America (Remote)

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST)

Employment Type: Full-Time International Independent Contractor


If you're excited about building products used by millions of users, enjoy moving quickly, and want to make a meaningful impact across both web and mobile platforms, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Engenheiro Eletricista - Líder de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro Eletricista - Líder de Projetos em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Carga horária: 40h semanais

Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Eletricista com experiência sólida em projetos elétricos, para atuar como líder técnico e gestor de equipe de projetistas. Este profissional será responsável pela condução técnica de projetos de subestações de alta tensão (69 à 230kV), garantindo o alinhamento entre qualidade, prazos e resultados esperados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e orientar equipe de projetistas na elaboração e revisão de projetos.
  • Coordenar atividades técnicas envolvendo projetos de subestações de alta tensão.
  • Realizar o planejamento e o acompanhamento de cronogramas dos projetos.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica das entregas e o cumprimento dos prazos definidos.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes e equipe interna.
  • Apoiar a padronização de processos e a melhoria contínua da área de engenharia.


Qualificações e Requisitos:

  • Formação completa em Engenharia Elétrica.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos eletromecânicos de subestações de alta tensão, incluindo: arranjos básicos, unifilares, cortes e vistas eletromecânicos, malha de aterramento.
  • Conhecimento avançado em AutoCAD, Revit e Pacote Office.
  • Experiência com liderança de equipes técnicas e múltiplos projetos simultâneos.
  • Perfil com alto nível de organização, autonomia e foco em resultados.


Diferenciais:

  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas e regulatórias do setor elétrico.
  • Vivência em interface com distribuidoras de energia.
  • Experiência com times remotos e ferramentas de colaboração à distância.


Informações:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Salário fixo + variável (formato OTE).
  • Cartão iFood.
  • PLR com distribuição anual.
  • Contrato PJ.

title: Engenheiro de dados - Data Modeler
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados - Data Modeler em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Data Modeler para atuar na construção, evolução e padronização dos modelos de dados corporativos, garantindo consistência, qualidade, integridade e aderência às necessidades de negócio e tecnologia.Esse profissional será responsável por apoiar iniciativas de modernização de sistemas, colaborando diretamente com times técnicos e áreas de negócio na definição de estruturas de dados eficientes e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Elaborar e manter modelos de dados conceituais, lógicos e físicos.
  • Garantir padronização e consistência na modelagem de dados corporativa.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de negócio para entendimento e tradução de requisitos em estruturas de dados.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e engenharia de dados na definição de soluções.
  • Realizar análise de impacto em alterações de estruturas e modelos de dados.
  • Definir relacionamentos, regras de integridade e padronização de nomenclaturas.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de governança e qualidade de dados.
  • Participar da evolução de modelos analíticos e transacionais.
  • Atuar na documentação de entidades, atributos, fluxos e dicionários de dados.
  • Apoiar processos de integração entre sistemas e plataformas.
  • Contribuir para melhoria contínua da arquitetura e organização dos dados corporativos.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em modelagem de dados conceitual, lógica e física.
  • Experiência com modelagem dimensional para ambientes analíticos (Star Schema).
  • Experiência com arquitetura medallion
  • Conhecimento em normalização e otimização de estruturas de dados (modelagem até 3NF).
  • Experiência com SQL e análise de estruturas de banco.
  • Conhecimento em integração de dados e processos ETL.
  • Vivência com documentação técnica e dicionário de dados.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos estruturados.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos e multidisciplinares.
  • Boa comunicação e interação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Forte conceito em harmonização de dados
  • Conhecimento em LGPD e segurança da informação.
  • Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais (conhecimento em Oracle 19c será um diferencial).


Informações Adicionais

  • Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho Remoto.
  • Horário de trabalho flexível: De acordo com área de atuação e política interna;
  • Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação Saúde e Cultura.

Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro Eletricista - Líder de Projetos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Carga horária: 40h semanais

Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Eletricista com experiência sólida em projetos elétricos, para atuar como líder técnico e gestor de equipe de projetistas. Este profissional será responsável pela condução técnica de projetos de subestações de alta tensão (69 à 230kV), garantindo o alinhamento entre qualidade, prazos e resultados esperados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e orientar equipe de projetistas na elaboração e revisão de projetos.
  • Coordenar atividades técnicas envolvendo projetos de subestações de alta tensão.
  • Realizar o planejamento e o acompanhamento de cronogramas dos projetos.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica das entregas e o cumprimento dos prazos definidos.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes e equipe interna.
  • Apoiar a padronização de processos e a melhoria contínua da área de engenharia.


Qualificações e Requisitos:

  • Formação completa em Engenharia Elétrica.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos eletromecânicos de subestações de alta tensão, incluindo: arranjos básicos, unifilares, cortes e vistas eletromecânicos, malha de aterramento.
  • Conhecimento avançado em AutoCAD, Revit e Pacote Office.
  • Experiência com liderança de equipes técnicas e múltiplos projetos simultâneos.
  • Perfil com alto nível de organização, autonomia e foco em resultados.


Diferenciais:

  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas e regulatórias do setor elétrico.
  • Vivência em interface com distribuidoras de energia.
  • Experiência com times remotos e ferramentas de colaboração à distância.


Informações:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Salário fixo + variável (formato OTE).
  • Cartão iFood.
  • PLR com distribuição anual.
  • Contrato PJ.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React & Node)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (React & Node) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (React & Node.js) com forte experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos, arquitetura de microfrontends, sistemas distribuídos e backend escalável.


O(a) profissional ideal possui profundo conhecimento em arquitetura moderna de frontend (React 18+, Microfrontends, Zustand, React Query, Next.js) e backend robusto com Node.js e NestJS, aplicando Clean Code, SOLID, DDD e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Será responsável por desenhar soluções escaláveis, garantindo performance, confiabilidade, segurança e integração entre múltiplos sistemas.


Responsabilidades:


Frontend (React)

  • Desenvolver aplicações escaláveis com React 18+ utilizando hooks avançados e composition patterns.
  • Implementar e manter arquitetura de Microfrontends (Single-SPA) .
  • Gerenciar estados assíncronos com Zustand, zustand-pub e React Query .
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis e responsivos com Styled Components .
  • Otimizar performance (Suspense, lazy loading, memoization).
  • Implementar fluxo offline e deduplicação de requisições.
  • Configurar e otimizar Webpack 5 .
  • Desenvolver testes unitários e de integração (Jest).
  • Implementar monitoramento com Sentry, Datadog ou NewRelic.
  • Aplicar Clean Code, SOLID e DDD no frontend.
  • Integrar soluções de pagamento (Pix, boletos, gateways).
  • Atuar em ambientes com CI/CD e Docker.


Backend (Node.js / NestJS)

  • Desenvolver serviços escaláveis com Node.js (v20+) e NestJS 11+ .
  • Implementar arquitetura modular e padrão BFF.
  • Criar e manter APIs REST com retry, timeout e circuit breaker.
  • Implementar autenticação com JWT e OAuth2.
  • Garantir segurança de APIs (OWASP Top 10, rate limiting, sanitização).
  • Implementar observabilidade com Winston, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana e ELK.
  • Desenvolver testes unitários e integração com Jest e Supertest.
  • Atuar com serviços AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, CloudWatch, IAM).
  • Containerizar aplicações com Docker.
  • Documentar APIs com @nestjs/swagger e versionamento adequado.



Competências Técnicas


Frontend:

  • React 18+, hooks avançados, Context API.
  • TypeScript avançado.
  • Microfrontends (Single-SPA).
  • Zustand e arquitetura Pub/Sub.
  • React Query.
  • Next.js (SSR, RSC, App Router).
  • Webpack 5.
  • Jest.
  • Gitflow ou Trunk-Based Development.

Backend:

  • Node.js (v20+).
  • NestJS 11+.
  • Arquitetura modular.
  • Interceptors, Pipes e Middleware.
  • Injeção de dependência.
  • APIs REST.
  • Logging, métricas e observabilidade.
  • AWS.
  • Docker e CI/CD.
  • Segurança de APIs.



Sobre a OSF Digital


A OSF é uma consultoria global que nasceu em Quebec, no Canadá, e hoje atua em mais de 30 países. Somos um dos maiores parceiros Salesforce do mundo.

Já nascemos no modelo remoto — esse formato faz parte da nossa cultura e está totalmente consolidado.


Nosso foco é desenvolvimento contínuo, crescimento técnico e evolução profissional.


Oferecemos um pacote completo pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, impulsionar seu desenvolvimento e acelerar sua carreira.


Benefícios:

• Vale Refeição ou Alimentação

• Assistência Médica

• Assistência Odontológica

• Seguro de Vida

• Gym Pass

• Auxílio Home Office / Educação

E tem mais! Aqui você também conta com programas que impulsionam o seu crescimento:

• Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos

• Programa de Indicação de Profissionais com bonificação

title: LATAM Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LATAM Accountant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LATAM Accountant

Brazil | Remote


About Sycomp

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.


About the Role


We are looking for a detail-oriented LATAM Accountant to support accounting operations across multiple countries in the region. This role will play a key part in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end close, and ensuring compliance with GAAP, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.


You will work closely with internal finance teams and external partners, supporting day-to-day accounting activities while contributing to accurate and timely financial reporting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the full month-end close process for assigned LATAM entities, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Prepare and post journal entries, reconcile balance sheet and intercompany accounts
  • Review and validate transactions across AP, AR, billing, and financial operations
  • Maintain alignment between Oracle and local statutory books
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing required documentation
  • Execute tax accounting activities and support statutory compliance across LATAM
  • Ensure adherence to internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Sales Operations, Tax, Legal, and external providers


Requirements

  • CPA (or equivalent certification) required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
  • Minimum 4 years of accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP / IFRS and accounting operations
  • Experience with AP processes and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Solid understanding of LATAM tax and statutory compliance (Brazil experience preferred)
  • Experience with ERP systems (Oracle preferred)
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.


Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at


Sycomp may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or identifying relevant experience. These tools assist our teams, and all hiring decisions are made following human review.

  • Participar ativamente de decisões arquiteturais e definição de boas práticas.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java e ecossistema Spring (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data).
  • Forte domínio de Programação Orientada a Objetos e princípios SOLID.
  • Experiência comprovada com Arquitetura Hexagonal, Clean Architecture e Design Patterns.
  • Experiência com Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos e mensageria (ex: Kafka, SQS, SNS).
  • Experiência prática com AWS (S3, SQS, SNS, Aurora).
  • Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou Oracle), incluindo modelagem e otimização avançada de queries.
  • Experiência com Docker e containerização.
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (JUnit, testes de integração, boas práticas de cobertura).
  • Experiência com versionamento utilizando Git.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de observabilidade e monitoramento (logs, métricas).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e microsserviços.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD.
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps.

A OSF é uma consultoria global que nasceu em Quebec, no Canadá, e hoje atua em mais de 30 países. Somos um dos maiores parceiros Salesforce do mundo.
